analyzed_vuln.description: The parser accepts malformed V2000 SGroup vector-data lines (SAL/SBL/SPA) where numeric fields are missing or blank, and `ParseSGroupIntField()` can yield an invalid bookmark value that is still passed into `SubstanceGroup::addAtomWithBookmark()`. That function calls `getUniqueAtomWithBookmark()` and then dereferences the returned pointer (`atom->getIdx()`), leading to UB when the bookmark lookup returns a non-object/invalid pointer (invalid vptr) instead of a valid Atom. Root cause is insufficient validation/sanitization of parsed SGroup indices/bookmarks in the caller parser before use.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Input must reach Mol block property parsing with SGroup records: create an SGroup via `M  STY`, then provide malformed `M  SAL` (or related vector-data) content with truncated/blank element fields (as in the PoC). Through `MolDataStreamToMol()` -> `ParseMolBlockProperties()` -> `ParseSGroupV2000VectorDataLine()`, the malformed entry is interpreted as an atom bookmark and forwarded to `addAtomWithBookmark()` without robust validity checks, triggering invalid Atom pointer use and UBSan invalid-vptr crash.
